t: That Public Law 154 (Eighty-first Congress), making temporary appropriations for the fiscal year 1950, and for other purposes, is hereby amended by striking out, in section (c) thereof, “July 31, 1949” and inserting in lieu thereof “August 15, 1949”.

fable.w: This section merely extends the date of a temporary appropriations law from July 31, 1949 to August 15, 1949. There is no tempting reading here: no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue is mentioned, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
